messages:
alex_devex: Heads up — multiple support tickets reporting intermittent 401s after the SDK regen that merged this morning. Seems to affect TS and Python clients on POSTs with Idempotency headers. Anyone seen this?

mira_support: Confirmed. Customers A, B, C reported same. Repro steps from one customer pasted below.

mira_support: curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/submit" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \
  -d '{"foo":"bar"}'

mira_support: Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
  { "error": "invalid_signature" }

ci-bot: autogen/regenerator ran on spec commit abc123 -> clients generated for python/ts/go. PR #458 merged at 2345660000. regen-ci passed on unit suites.

jasper_eng: Looking at gateway logs — requests hit the gateway and auth header present, but canonical string used for signature differs from what the client sends post-regen. Can you paste raw request captured from failing client?

alex_devex: Minimal TS repro (from customer):
```ts
const res = await fetch(url, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Idempotency-Key': id,
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
  },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
});
```

alex_devex: When using the older client the gateway accepted it. After regen the same payload returns 401.

jasper_eng: I bisected the regen templates — template change in codegen v2.0.1 introduced header-join util that outputs headers sorted alphabetically to keep generated client output deterministic. That changed the emitted header ordering: Authorization now comes after Idempotency-Key in some generated clients.

sam_runtime: Our signature verification SHOULD be order-independent: it must canonicalize headers (lowercase, sort keys) before signing. If it's sensitive to order that's a bug in verification.

jasper_eng: Exactly — the server was relying on insertion order to build the canonical string (legacy code path). Regen revealed it because client-side canonical string changed. So two concurrent bugs: codegen changed header ordering (intentional), and runtime didn't canonicalize properly.

mira_support: Immediate mitigation for customers? Some reported retries causing billing spikes too.

sam_runtime: Short-term: I'll patch signature verification to explicitly canonicalize header names and sort them before computing the string. Rolling out to canary in us-west-2 now. If canary looks good we'll promote.

sam_runtime: Also opened incident INC-789 and queued rollback option on the regen release if rollout causes more failures.

alex_devex: On the client side, can we add a regen-ci test that fails if header emission order changes significantly (to catch behavior-impacting changes)?

hana_devtooling: We should be careful — deterministic output is useful for diffs. Instead add a compatibility test that verifies the canonical string computed by a reference server matches the client. That prevents order-only regressions from shipping unnoticed.

jasper_eng: Agreed. I'll add a unit that computes client canonical string and asserts it matches server codepath (both canonicalize internally). Also adding a changelog note: "regen: header emission order adjusted for deterministic output — requires runtime canonicalization fix".

alex_devex: For immediate customer comms: Mira, please notify affected customers with workaround: patch gateway to accept header permutations or temporarily set Idempotency-Key after Authorization in client. Also offer billing credits for retry-related spikes.

mira_support: On it. I'll send a targeted CX message and offer credits. Please link the incident.

ci-bot: job/2345679000 created: runtime/signature-normalizer -> canary us-west-2.

deploy-bot: canary deployed (job/2345679000). Monitoring traces for invalid_signature errors.

sam_runtime: Canary looks good at +15m, error rate down 98% for affected routes. Promoting to prod in 10.

alex_devex: Great. Open follow-ups:
- codegen PR to add compatibility test + minor template tweak to avoid breaking changelogs
- regen-ci add server-client canonicalization test
- postmortem documenting why deterministic regen surfaced a runtime bug
- credits for customers impacted

hana_devtooling: I'll draft the regen-ci test and push a PR in codegen repo.

jasper_eng: FYI also found one edge: Go client uses map iteration to build headers then converts to slice — ensure template sorts keys consistently to avoid flakiness across runs.

mira_support: Thanks all, closing loop with customers.

alex_devex: :thumbsup: I'll start the postmortem template and add notes to devex docs about regen pitfalls.

mira_support: Marking this thread resolved once credits issued and prod fix confirmed.

ci-bot: incident/INC-789 updated: root cause identified + mitigation deployed.
